_comment: Response transformers from src/backend/database/routes/host-normalizers.ts and friends. `transformHostResponse` and `stripSensitiveFields` are modeled precisely in src/transformers.ts (built from the live Drizzle `hosts` table, not hand-typed field lists, so they track schema changes automatically). Everything else here is only named so a response passed through it gets a clear x-confidence note instead of silently falling back to `unknown`.
